mapper.sql: id, name, description, tool_names, system_prompt, scope, agent_id, scene_key, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT FROM skill WHERE scope = 'AGENT' AND agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT FROM skill WHERE scope = 'GLOBAL' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT FROM skill WHERE scope = 'SCENE' AND scene_key = #{sceneKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill (name, description, tool_names, system_prompt, scope, agent_id, scene_key, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{toolNames}, #{systemPrompt}, #{scope}, #{agentId}, #{sceneKey}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, tool_names = #{toolNames}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, scope = #{scope}, agent_id = #{agentId}, scene_key = #{sceneKey}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
